providers.name: Devin CLI Agentic Bridge
providers.authHint: Authentication is owned by the official Devin CLI in its isolated bridge volume.

notice.text: This provider accepts only the official Devin CLI over local ACP stdio and never falls back to another provider.

providers.name: OpenCode Free
providers.freeNote: No API key required — public OpenCode endpoint with Kimi, GLM, Qwen, MiMo, MiniMax models.
providers.authHint: No API key required — uses OpenCode's public free endpoint.

notice.text: OpenCode Free uses the public OpenCode endpoint (https://opencode.ai/zen/v1). No signup or API key needed. Rate limits apply.

providers.name: DuckDuckGo AI Chat
providers.freeNote: Free — anonymous access to multiple AI models via DuckDuckGo.
providers.authHint: No credentials required — DuckDuckGo AI Chat is anonymous and free.

providers.name: Cloudflare AI Playground
providers.freeNote: Free — Cloudflare's AI Playground: GLM 5.2, Kimi K2.7 Code, DeepSeek V4 Pro, gpt-oss-120B and 16 more. No account, no API key.
providers.authHint: No credentials required — anonymous browser sessions over a reverse-engineered cf_agent WebSocket protocol (Playwright transport).

notice.text: Cloudflare AI Playground uses a reverse-engineered anonymous WebSocket protocol (no official API). Requires Playwright with a Chromium browser on first request. Rate limits apply per IP (error 3021).

providers.name: The Old LLM (Free)
providers.freeNote: Free — GPT-5.4, Claude 4.6 Opus/Sonnet/Haiku, + more. No API key — tokens auto-generated via browser.
providers.authHint: No credentials required. The executor auto-generates access tokens via an embedded Playwright browser instance.

providers.name: Chipotle Pepper AI (Free)
providers.freeNote: Free — Chipotle's Pepper AI (IPsoft Amelia). Anonymous sessions, no API key. Rate-limited.
providers.authHint: No credentials required. Uses Chipotle's public support chatbot via reverse-engineered SockJS/STOMP protocol.

providers.name: Veo AI Free
providers.freeNote: Free video generation — VEO 3.1, Seedance. 6 requests/hour.
providers.authHint: No auth required. Rate limited to 6 requests/hour per IP.

providers.name: Augment (Auggie CLI)
providers.freeNote: Local passthrough — runs the Augment CLI (`auggie`) on this machine. Auth is handled by `auggie login`, not ShiguangGateway.
providers.authHint: No API key stored by ShiguangGateway. Install the Auggie CLI and run `auggie login` on this machine, then ShiguangGateway spawns it locally for each request.

notice.text: Augment (Auggie CLI) requires the `auggie` binary installed and authenticated locally (`auggie login`). ShiguangGateway spawns it as a subprocess and never sees or stores your Augment credentials.

providers.name: ZCode (GLM Coding Plan)
providers.authHint: No API key stored by ShiguangGateway. The local ZCode app-server uses the existing builtin:zai-coding-plan login.

notice.text: ZCode runs locally through its native app-server. ShiguangGateway never receives or stores the Z.ai credential.

providers.name: OpenAI Codex (App-Server)
providers.authHint: No token stored by ShiguangGateway. The Codex CLI app-server manages its own ChatGPT sign-in (~/.codex/auth.json, auto-refreshed). Use “Sign in with ChatGPT” if the CLI is not yet authenticated.

notice.text: OpenAI Codex (App-Server) drives the Codex CLI's local app-server (JSON-RPC over WebSocket). The CLI self-manages its OpenAI OAuth, so ShiguangGateway never sees or replays your token. Requires the codex CLI reachable at the configured app-server URL; sign in via the CLI or the dashboard “Sign in with ChatGPT” action.

providers.name: UncloseAI
providers.freeNote: Free forever — no signup, no credit card. OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
providers.authHint: No auth required. API accepts any non-empty string as key for identification. If older built-in models return 404, use Available Models → Import from /models or Auto-Sync; verified live model: solidrust/Hermes-3-Llama-3.1-8B-AWQ.

notice.text: UncloseAI needs no API key. API accepts any non-empty string as key for identification. If older built-in models return 404, use Available Models → Import from /models or Auto-Sync.

providers.name: AI Horde
providers.freeNote: Crowdsourced inference from volunteer GPUs. Throughput is a shared queue, not a quota: there is no RPM/RPD cap, but waits grow when the network is busy.
providers.authHint: No API key required — uses AI Horde's documented anonymous key. Adding a free aihorde.net key is optional and only buys higher queue priority (kudos).

notice.text: AI Horde routes to volunteer-run workers, so chat and image jobs can take minutes and tool calling is unavailable. Chat models come from the live oai.aihorde.net catalog. Image models are listed only while Horde reports at least one worker. An optional aihorde.net API key raises queue priority (kudos).

providers.name: GitHub Enterprise Copilot
providers.authHint: Enter your GHE instance URL (e.g., https://ghe.company.com) in provider settings, then authenticate via device flow.

providers.name: xAI OAuth (Grok)
providers.authHint: Sign in with xAI to use api.x.ai models such as Grok 4.5. This is separate from Grok Build JWT sessions, which use cli-chat-proxy.grok.com and grok-build model aliases.

providers.name: Openference
providers.freeNote: Free plan: 3-day trial with open-source models — no credit card required
providers.authHint: Sign in with your Openference account to route requests through api.openference.com. An active plan is required for inference — OAuth may authenticate but return 402 without one.

providers.name: Grok Build
providers.authHint: Sign in with your browser, or paste your ~/.grok/auth.json (or the JWT access token) from the Grok Build CLI; refresh_token is rotated automatically either way.

providers.name: Antigravity CLI
providers.authHint: Import your Antigravity CLI (`agy`) login (paste/upload its token file), auto-detect a local CLI login, or sign in with Google. Shares the Antigravity backend (incl. Claude models).

providers.name: Kiro AI
providers.freeNote: Free tier: 50 credits/month (~25K–100K tokens). ⚠️ Kiro ToS prohibits third-party proxy/harness use.

providers.name: Amazon Q
providers.authHint: Uses the same AWS Builder ID or imported refresh-token flow as Kiro, but keeps Amazon Q connections separate.

providers.name: GitLab Duo
providers.authHint: GitLab Duo OAuth is not configured. Register an OAuth application at https://gitlab.com/-/profile/applications with redirect URI http://localhost:8787/callback and scopes "ai_features read_user", then set GITLAB_DUO_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID (and optionally GITLAB_DUO_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET) and restart.

providers.name: Zed IDE
providers.authHint: Zed stores LLM provider credentials (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, xAI) in the OS keychain. Use the Import button below to discover and import them automatically.

providers.name: Zed Hosted Models
providers.authHint: Sign in with your Zed account (native-app sign-in). ShiguangGateway generates a one-time RSA keypair and opens zed.dev to authorize it — on a remote/headless install, copy the resulting 127.0.0.1 callback URL from your browser's address bar and paste it back here. Distinct from the 'Zed IDE' credential-import entry above: this proxies chat completions through Zed's own hosted model aggregator (cloud.zed.dev), fronting Anthropic/OpenAI/Google/xAI models under your Zed plan.

providers.name: Trae
providers.authHint: Trae is an AI-native IDE by ByteDance (SOLO remote agent). Authorize via trae.ai in the popup, or sign in at solo.trae.ai and paste the Cloud-IDE-JWT (sent as 'Authorization: Cloud-IDE-JWT <token>', ~14-day lifetime) as the access token; web_id/biz_user_id/user_unique_id/scope/tenant/region propagate via providerSpecificData. No headless refresh for pasted tokens — re-paste on expiry.

providers.name: Kimi Code CLI
providers.authHint: Sign in with the same Kimi account used by Kimi Code CLI. ShiguangGateway uses the CLI OAuth flow and Kimi Coding Plan endpoints.

providers.name: ClinePass
providers.authHint: ClinePass is Cline's $9.99/mo subscription bundling 10 open coding models. Sign in with your Cline account (same login as the Cline CLI/IDE), or paste a direct ClinePass API key (app.cline.bot → Settings → API Keys). A ClinePass subscription unlocks the cline-pass/* models. Reuses the Cline WorkOS OAuth flow.

providers.name: Devin Desktop
providers.authHint: Paste an existing Devin API key from an authenticated Devin session. Key export availability and steps vary by Devin version and account.

providers.name: Devin CLI
providers.authHint: Requires the Devin CLI binary. Run `devin auth login` to authenticate, or provide your WINDSURF_API_KEY. Install: https://cli.devin.ai

providers.name: CodeBuddy CN
providers.authHint: Tencent CodeBuddy CN (copilot.tencent.com). Sign in via the official CLI device-code flow, or paste a direct API key (sent as Authorization: Bearer). Catalog: GLM / Kimi / MiniMax / DeepSeek / Hunyuan.

providers.name: ChatGPT Web (Codex)
providers.authHint: Paste the full ChatGPT Cookie header. ShiguangGateway verifies it in an isolated headless browser profile.

providers.name: Grok Web (Subscription)
providers.authHint: Paste the full grok.com cookie line from DevTools → Application → Cookies. Include both `sso` and `sso-rw` (e.g. `sso=...; sso-rw=...`) — Grok's anti-bot rejects `sso` on its own.

providers.name: Gemini Web (Free)
providers.authHint: Paste the full cookie header, the __Secure-1PSID value, or the JSON export containing cookies from gemini.google.com. Include __Secure-1PSIDTS and __Secure-1PSIDCC when available.

providers.name: Perplexity Web (Pro/Max)
providers.authHint: Paste your __Secure-next-auth.session-token cookie value from perplexity.ai

providers.name: Blackbox Web (Subscription)
providers.authHint: Paste your __Secure-authjs.session-token value or full cookie header from app.blackbox.ai

providers.name: Muse Spark Web (Meta AI)
providers.freeNote: Free with login — Meta AI platform with Llama models.
providers.authHint: Paste your ecto_1_sess cookie AND the ecto1:... WS auth token from meta.ai. Capture the ecto1: token in DevTools → Network → WS → the clippy request's Authorization query param. Example: ecto_1_sess=4240a308...NVDg0; ecto1:ABCD...

providers.name: Claude Web
providers.authHint: Paste your session cookie from claude.ai

providers.name: DeepSeek Web
providers.authHint: Paste your userToken from chat.deepseek.com — DevTools → Application → Local Storage → userToken

providers.name: Microsoft Copilot Web
providers.authHint: Paste the access_token from an authenticated copilot.microsoft.com request (DevTools → Network → Authorization), or export a HAR while logged in

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot (BizChat)
providers.authHint: Sign in at m365.cloud.microsoft/chat, then open DevTools → Network → filter 'WS' → click the Chathub WebSocket connection. Copy both the access_token query parameter AND the account-specific Chathub path segment from its request URL (wss://…/Chathub/<path>?…&access_token=…). It is NOT an Authorization: Bearer header on an XHR/Fetch request. The token is short-lived; this is an unofficial integration. Optional: store a refresh_token in providerSpecificData.refreshToken (any Microsoft device-code/refresh flow for the substrate.office.com/sydney scopes) and ShiguangGateway pre-flight-refreshes the access token itself — otherwise re-capture after every ~75 min expiry.

providers.name: t3.chat (Pro/Free)
providers.freeNote: Free tier gives limited model access. Pro ($8/month) unlocks 50+ models.
providers.authHint: Open t3.chat in your browser, log in, then open DevTools → Application → Local Storage → https://t3.chat. Copy the value of 'convex-session-id'. Also open DevTools → Network, copy the Cookie header from any request. Paste both values here. See provider setup docs for a step-by-step guide.

providers.name: Inner.ai (Subscription)
providers.authHint: Paste your token cookie and email separated by a space: open DevTools → Application → Cookies → .innerai.com, copy the token value, then append a space and your Inner.ai login email. Example: eyJhbG... user@example.com

providers.name: Adapta.org (Adapta One Web)
providers.authHint: Paste your __client cookie value from .clerk.agent.adapta.one (DevTools → Application → Cookies)

providers.name: Arena (Free)
providers.freeNote: Free model comparison platform (formerly LMArena) at arena.ai — Direct-chat catalog of chat models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, …). No subscription required.
providers.authHint: Paste the full Cookie header from arena.ai (DevTools → Network → request → Cookie). Include arena-auth-prod-v1.0/.1… and cf_clearance/__cf_bm when present. ShiguangGateway uses Chrome TLS impersonation; if Arena still 403s, set providerSpecificData.recaptchaV3Token from a live browser session.

providers.name: Tencent Yuanbao (Free)
providers.freeNote: Free consumer web session — DeepSeek V3/R1 and Hunyuan / Hunyuan-T1, optional web search. No subscription required. Rate limits apply.
providers.authHint: Log in to yuanbao.tencent.com, then paste the full Cookie header (DevTools → Network → any /api request → Request Headers → Cookie). It must contain hy_user and hy_token.

providers.name: Tencent AI Studio (Free)
providers.freeNote: Free web session on Tencent AI Studio (aistudio.tencent.ai) — Direct chat with Hunyuan models (hy3-g, HunyuanDefault, Hunyuan3D). Cookie authentication.
providers.authHint: Log in to aistudio.tencent.ai, open DevTools -> Network, copy any request Cookie header containing session tokens.

providers.name: HuggingChat (Free)
providers.freeNote: Free LLM chat — no subscription required. Rate limits apply.
providers.authHint: Paste the full Cookie header from huggingface.co/chat (DevTools → Network → /chat/conversation → Request Headers → Cookie). It should include hf-chat and may also include token / aws-waf-token.

providers.name: Poe Web (Subscription)
providers.authHint: Paste your p-b cookie value from poe.com (DevTools → Application → Cookies → p-b)

providers.name: Venice Web (Privacy)
providers.authHint: Paste your session cookie from venice.ai (DevTools → Application → Cookies)

providers.name: v0 Vercel Web (Code Gen)
providers.authHint: Paste your session cookie from v0.dev (DevTools → Application → Cookies)

providers.name: Kimi Web
providers.authHint: Paste access_token from www.kimi.ai DevTools → Application → Local Storage. A legacy kimi-auth cookie is also accepted.

providers.name: Dola Web (ByteDance)
providers.authHint: Paste the full Cookie header from www.dola.com. It should include sessionid, ttwid, and s_v_web_id. If s_v_web_id is unavailable, fp=verify_... from a chat/completion request URL can be used as a fallback.

providers.name: Gemini Business (Enterprise)
providers.freeNote: Free for Google Workspace enterprise accounts — enterprise Gemini models (Pro, Flash, image, video) via direct StreamGenerate HTTP API. No subscription required, just enterprise SSO.
providers.authHint: From your enterprise account: open business.gemini.google/home/cid/{your-cid}, then copy __Secure-1PSID and __Secure-1PSIDTS cookies from DevTools → Application → Cookies. Paste as a cookie header below.

providers.name: ZenMux Free (Web)
providers.freeNote: Free tier (5 Flows/5h, 38.64 Flows/week) — DeepSeek V3.2, GLM 4.7 Flash Free and more. No subscription required.
providers.authHint: Login at zenmux.ai, then export all cookies using EditThisCookie or Cookie-Editor and paste the full Cookie header string here. Refresh every ~30 days.

providers.name: TinyCMS Web (Free/Sub)
providers.freeNote: Free tier has access to GPT 5.4, Gemini 3.5, and Grok 4.20 models. No login required. Subscription grants 300 requests/day for advanced models.
providers.authHint: Go to site.tinycms.xyz, open DevTools → Application → Local Storage, copy the value of 'app-config-uuid' (starts with 'R'), and paste it here.

providers.name: Z.ai Web
providers.freeNote: Consumer web session for the four models currently visible in chat.z.ai. Distinct from the API-key zai/glm providers.
providers.authHint: Copy the "token" value from chat.z.ai → DevTools → Application → Local Storage. Do not copy cookies; ShiguangGateway handles the per-request CAPTCHA through its browser transport.

providers.name: PromptQL (Unofficial/Experimental)
providers.authHint: Paste the Bearer JWT from prompt.ql.app DevTools → Network → graphql → Authorization (token only). Optional projectId + session Cookie for refresh.

providers.name: Notion AI Web (Unofficial/Experimental)
providers.authHint: Paste only the token_v2 cookie VALUE from app.notion.com (DevTools → Application → Cookies → token_v2). Do not paste token_v2= or the full Cookie header. Workspace is auto-detected; space_id / notion_user_id are optional.

providers.name: Adobe Firefly (Image/Video)
providers.authHint: RECOMMENDED: firefly.adobe.com signed-in → F12 → Network → click firefly-3p.ff.adobe.io (generate-async or models/discovery) → Request Headers → Authorization → copy the token AFTER 'Bearer ' (starts with eyJ…). Cookie-only from firefly.adobe.com mints a GUEST token → 401/403; only multi-domain IMS cookies (adobelogin.com) or that Bearer JWT work. Unofficial/experimental media + Limits.

providers.name: HyperAgent (Unofficial/Experimental)
providers.authHint: Paste the full Cookie header from hyperagent.com (DevTools → Network → any request → Request Headers → Cookie). Session cookies power chat + billing usage.

providers.name: Conol (Unofficial/Experimental)
providers.authHint: Use browser sign-in, or paste the full Cookie header from conol.ai. The __Secure-better-auth.session_token cookie is required.

providers.name: MLX Gemma 26B
providers.authHint: No API key required. Runs mlx-lm server locally on port 11435. Requires uv and mlx-lm installed. Model: mlx-community/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-q4_0-mlx-aligned (~15.9GB peak memory).

providers.name: MLX Qwen 3.8 27B
providers.authHint: No API key required. Runs mlx-lm server locally on port 11436. Requires uv and mlx-lm installed. Model: maglun/Qwen3.8-27B-MLX-Mixed-3.80bpw (~13.1GB peak memory).

providers.name: Ollama
providers.authHint: No API key required. Ollama runs locally — configure its OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: http://localhost:11434/v1) and make sure Ollama is running before connecting.

providers.name: LM Studio
providers.authHint: API key optional. Configure the local LM Studio OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: http://localhost:1234/v1).

providers.name: vLLM
providers.authHint: API key optional. Configure the local vLLM OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: http://localhost:8000/v1).

providers.name: Lemonade Server
providers.authHint: API key optional. Configure the local Lemonade OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: http://localhost:13305/api/v1).

providers.name: Llamafile
providers.authHint: API key optional. Configure the local Llamafile OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1).

providers.name: llama.cpp
providers.authHint: API key optional (use any value, e.g. sk-no-key-required). Configure the llama-server OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1). Note: if Llamafile is also installed, both default to port 8080 — run only one at a time or override the port.

providers.name: NVIDIA Triton
providers.authHint: API key optional. Configure the Triton OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: http://localhost:8000/v1).

providers.name: Docker Model Runner
providers.authHint: API key optional. Configure the local Docker Model Runner OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: http://localhost:12434/v1).

providers.name: XInference
providers.authHint: API key optional. Configure the local XInference OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: http://localhost:9997/v1).

providers.name: oobabooga
providers.authHint: API key optional. Configure the local oobabooga OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: http://localhost:5000/v1).

providers.name: SD WebUI
providers.authHint: No API key required. Configure the local WebUI base URL (default: http://localhost:7860).

providers.name: ComfyUI
providers.authHint: No API key required. Configure the local ComfyUI base URL (default: http://localhost:8188).

providers.name: Perplexity Search
providers.authHint: Same API key as Perplexity (pplx-...)

providers.name: Serper Search
providers.authHint: API key from serper.dev dashboard

providers.name: Brave Search
providers.authHint: Subscription token from Brave Search API dashboard

providers.name: Exa Search
providers.authHint: API key from dashboard.exa.ai

providers.name: Tavily Search
providers.authHint: API key from app.tavily.com (format: tvly-...)

providers.name: AnySearch
providers.authHint: Optional API key from anysearch.com (as_sk_...) - free 1000/day; keyless tier has lower limits

providers.name: Firecrawl
providers.authHint: API key from firecrawl.dev/app/api-keys (or set your self-hosted Firecrawl base URL)

notice.text: Free tier: 1,000 credits/month. Powers /v1/web/fetch and /v1/search.

providers.name: Google Programmable Search
providers.authHint: Requires a Google API key and your Programmable Search Engine ID (cx)

providers.name: Nimble Search
providers.authHint: Bearer API key from the Nimble dashboard

providers.name: Linkup Search
providers.authHint: Bearer API key from the Linkup dashboard

providers.name: SearchAPI
providers.authHint: API key from SearchAPI (query param or Bearer auth)

providers.name: You.com Search
providers.authHint: X-API-Key from the You.com platform dashboard

providers.name: SearXNG Search
providers.authHint: API key is optional. Set your SearXNG base URL. Some instances may require a bearer token for access.

providers.name: X Search (Grok)
providers.authHint: SuperGrok OAuth (xai-oauth) or xAI API key. This is Grok X Search, not the X Developer MCP.

providers.name: Xquik X Search
providers.authHint: Xquik API key (xq_...). Search is metered per returned post; the catalog estimate uses 5 results.

providers.name: Ollama Search
providers.authHint: Same API key as Ollama Cloud (from ollama.com/settings/keys)

providers.name: Context7 (library docs)
providers.authHint: API key optional (ctx7sk-...) — anonymous tier works without a key; a key raises the rate limit

providers.name: AWS Polly
providers.authHint: Use AWS Secret Access Key as API key; set providerSpecificData.accessKeyId and optional region.

providers.name: Speechmatics

providers.authHint: Jules API key for creating and managing cloud coding tasks.

providers.name: Devin
providers.authHint: Devin API key for cloud agent sessions.

providers.name: Codex Cloud
providers.authHint: OpenAI API key with Codex Cloud task access.

providers.name: 1min.AI
providers.authHint: Create an API key at https://docs.1min.ai/docs/api/create-api-key, then paste it here.

providers.name: Freebuff
providers.freeNote: Free Codebuff / Freebuff AI models.
providers.authHint: Enter Freebuff / Codebuff Auth Token (obtained via CLI login or automated harvester).

providers.name: LiteRouter

providers.name: MNN AI

providers.name: MegaNova AI

providers.name: Mixlayer
providers.freeNote: The qwen/qwen3.5-4b-free model is free for prototyping and rate-limited; no fixed public RPM or daily quota is confirmed.

providers.name: Speka AI
providers.freeNote: Free plan: $1 monthly usage, 10 RPM, one API key and access to open models and the playground; no card required.

providers.name: TokenReply
providers.freeNote: Free-tagged models have model- and campaign-specific daily limits; no fixed global free quota is published.

providers.name: Yolo-Auto
providers.freeNote: Free API access is request-limited and intended for testing; no numeric daily quota is published and free access is not promised indefinitely.

providers.name: DXNT / DX Token
providers.freeNote: Free accounts are documented at 100 calls/day; the quota may increase through invitations and can vary by account.

providers.name: CloudCode.ONE
providers.freeNote: Published free models include glm-4.7-flash and glm-4.6v-flash; no numeric quota is published, and key creation may require credit or a coupon.

providers.name: OfoxAI
providers.freeNote: The current catalog advertises 10+ free models without a public numeric quota; review upstream provenance, retention and training terms before production use.

providers.name: ZeroLimitAI
providers.freeNote: Temporary free trial is advertised, but official pages conflict between 3 and 7 days; a 100-calls/day claim is not treated as permanent.

providers.name: ChatAnywhere
providers.freeNote: Personal, educational or research use only: public documentation cites 10,000 points/day and 200 requests/day per IP/key; do not use for commercial traffic.

providers.name: Helyx AI
providers.freeNote: Operational Free plan documents 100,000 tokens/day; the site's separate 2M+ marketing claim conflicts and is not treated as a quota guarantee.

providers.name: Auriko
providers.freeNote: Free plan publishes 1,000 Platform RPM and 10,000 BYOK RPM. Platform inference still passes through provider cost; this is not a free-token pool or unlimited free inference.

providers.name: Poixe AI
providers.freeNote: Current public free limits are small and model-group specific: 2 RPM/5 RPD for large-cup models and 20 RPM/50 RPD for small-cup models.

providers.name: Naga AI

providers.authHint: Bearer API key for api.jina.ai — embeddings, rerank, classify, segment, and search. Dashboard keys take precedence over JINA_AI_API_KEY. This is not the Reader / r.jina.ai card and does not fetch URLs.

providers.name: Segmind
providers.freeNote: Free trial credits on signup, no credit card required (per Segmind's public docs).
providers.authHint: Use your Segmind API key in the x-api-key header. ShiguangGateway targets https://api.segmind.com/v1/<model> and returns the generated image/video bytes directly.

providers.name: Dify
providers.freeNote: Free open-source AI app builder + RAG platform.
providers.authHint: Get API key from your Dify instance.

providers.name: Nomic
providers.freeNote: Free Nomic Embed API. Open-source embeddings, no credit card required.
providers.authHint: Get API key at atlas.nomic.ai

providers.name: Mixedbread AI
providers.freeNote: Free-tier API key via signup, no credit card required.
providers.authHint: Bearer API key for the Mixedbread embeddings API.

providers.name: Jina Reader (r.jina.ai)
providers.authHint: Bearer API key for r.jina.ai URL-to-markdown (/v1/web/fetch only). Does not serve /v1/embeddings or /v1/rerank. The same Jina token as Foundation API works; ShiguangGateway reuses a jina-ai dashboard key or JINA_AI_API_KEY when this card is empty.

notice.text: Reader / r.jina.ai only — not embeddings or rerank. Free tier: 1M fetches/month.

providers.name: TinyFish Fetch
providers.authHint: X-API-Key from agent.tinyfish.ai/api-keys

notice.text: Fetch does not use TinyFish credits. Submit up to 10 URLs per request (ShiguangGateway fetches one URL per call).

providers.name: DeepAI
providers.authHint: Use your DeepAI API key. Get one at deepai.org — requires a Pro subscription ($9.99/mo).

providers.name: Cursor API
providers.authHint: Paste a Cursor user API key (crsr_...) from cursor.com/dashboard/api. ShiguangGateway exchanges it for a session token on demand; no IDE or cursor-agent install is needed. Usage bills to the Cursor plan that owns the key.
